name: One More Credit
description:
About This Game

One More Credit is a single-player PvE roguelike autobattler set in a retro arcade. Pick your cartridges, line up their triggers, and see if your build holds up once the fight starts on its own.

Between fights, spend credits in the shop to buy cartridges and arrange them across your active slots. Placement matters: some cartridges buff or charge the ones next to them, while others react whenever an ally fires or lands a crit. Keep extras in reserve slots for later, then hit Fight and let your cartridges battle on their own cooldowns.

Buy a matching duplicate to rank a cartridge up toward Pink Diamond. Hitting Silver or Gold lets you pick one of three upgrades, adding new effects or even a second genre, while collectibles give your whole setup extra charge, speed, shields, burn, or poison.

  • Reroll or lock the shop to dig for the pieces you need, stash spares in reserve, and expand from four active slots up to eight.

  • Play different characters, each with their own cartridge pool and active hack skills you can pay credits to trigger before a fight.

  • Earn points from every run to level up characters and unlock new cartridges, collectibles, and hacks. Beat a run to unlock stacking difficulty levels and Endless Mode.

  • You start with three lives. Losing a regular fight costs one, and losing to the boss costs three. Spend your earned credits carefully between shop upgrades, rerolls, and pre-fight hacks.
short_desc: A PvE roguelike autobattler about building cartridge combos. Spend credits between fights to buy, arrange, and upgrade cartridges, then beat arcade bosses before your lives run out.
